title: Analysis of Tantalum Coatings Produced by the Kinetic Spray Process
InformationInFigures: Nozzle schematic; SEM photos of Ta powder; optical micrographs of powder grain boundaries; particle size distribution; theoretical exit gas velocity and particle velocity plots; tables of coating thickness, hardness, porosity, and adhesion; SEM/etched optical micrographs of coatings under diferent spray conditions.

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: Sponge-like / porous powder morphology (reported as sponge-like appearance in cross-section).
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: Particle size distribution measured by Malvern Mastersizer (volume-based).
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: Reduction of K2(TaF7) with sodium metal (reaction provided in paper).
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: Sandblasted to roughen surface and improve adhesion.

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: Kinetic spray (cold gas-dynamic spray) system with de Laval-type nozzle
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Powder feeder gas: N2 at room temperature. Powder feeder pressure: 1.7 MPa for He main-gas runs. Maximum coating thickness (Table 1) at 1 g/s feed rate: 1.68 mm.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: Adhesion strength: 11.4 kpsi; Failure mode: Epoxy. Coating thickness metric reported as maximum thickness at 1 g/s feed rate.

Experiments.Notes: Tantalum; Kinetic spray; Main gas=Helium; Nozzle=B; Main gas temperature=204°C.
